meta.attribution: Server records originate from the official MCP Registry maintained by the Model Context Protocol project.
meta.disclaimer: Compatibility verdicts are derived from published registry data and documented client behaviour. No connector was executed or audited.

connector.name: MCP Context Server
connector.registryDescription: An MCP server that provides persistent multimodal context storage for LLM agents.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-context-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the alex-feel account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
